basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old tech enthusiast from the Silicon Valley. By day, I'm a software engineer working for a mid-sized tech company. I have a passion for gaming, both on PC and console, and I spend much of my free time tweaking and optimizing my gaming setup. I'm also an avid music lover, often attending festivals like Coachella. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to explore various hobbies. I typically browse Reddit during the late evenings after work, usually around 8-11 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 15 years. My knowledge in gaming hardware and software optimization comes from years of personal interest and self-teaching, along with my professional experience in software development.
